title: **US Indirectly Killed 5 Million Innocent People After 9/11, Iranian Parliament Human Rights Chair Claims**
text:
**US Indirectly Killed 5 Million Innocent People After 9/11, Iranian Parliament Human Rights Chair Claims**"

"Sara Fallahi, Chair of the Human Rights Committee of the Iranian Parliament, also claimed that US and European sanctions have caused the deaths of more than 38 million innocent people since the 1970s and said Washington lacks the legal and moral standing to judge human rights."

"Sara Fallahi, Chair of the Human Rights Committee of the Iranian Parliament, said at a session presenting annual reports on human rights violations in the United States and Britain that sanctions imposed by Europe and the US since the 1970s had caused the deaths of more than 38 million innocent people."

"She also claimed that Americans had indirectly killed 5 million innocent people after the September 11 attacks."

"Emphasizing that the US is not qualified to assess human rights, Fallahi said: “Americans lack the legal and moral competence to sit in judgment on human rights in the world.”"

"The Iranian Parliament’s human rights committee chair added: “If you look at human rights violations by Americans in other countries, it is enough to look at American society itself and see that even Americans are the biggest violators of human rights inside their own country.”"

"Fallahi stated: “Americans have the largest prison system in the world, with more than 2 million people in US prisons, and many women in these prisons are forced into sexual slavery.”"

"She said: “Black people make up 13 percent of the US population, but in 2023, of the 1,200 people killed by police, 27 percent were Black.”
